config.note: Full historical development domain. One-step Geom-CFG x 8 seeds; no-CFG x 4 step counts x 8 paired seeds. Predeclared checkpoint, no seed selection, no training-seed claims.

mask_policy: historical dlib hull intersect closed/eroded GT; explicit fallback

metric_protocols.legacy: raw channel clamp, encode, then normalize; no PNG roundtrip
metric_protocols.float: FP32 normal normalized before export; same GT mask

diagnostic_design: paired inference seed x no-CFG integration steps; plus historical one-step Geom-CFG multi-seed

multiseed.std_definition: sample SD over 8 inference-seed dataset MAEs (ddof=1); also retain population SD for prior-pilot comparison
multiseed.seed_policy: historical per-image local generator reset: a seed gives the same initial field for every image; identical fields paired across steps/modes
multiseed.scope: fixed checkpoint, historical development domain; not training-seed variance or general-domain evidence

best_audit.scope: all non-followed entries: size/mtime/type; code/config/document content hashes
